mentions.name: Skyscraper for Bluesky
mentions.description: Independent Bluesky client for iPhone, iPad, and Apple Vision Pro — the first Bluesky client for Vision Pro. Focuses on a native iOS look and feel with scroll position permanence, greater emphasis on hashtags, and support for Shortcuts. Offered via monthly or annual subscriptions, launched three weeks prior and nearing 100 subscribers.
mentions.problem: The official Bluesky client wasn't enjoyable and didn't fit the author's particular tastes.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on Skyscraper for Bluesky, which is an independent Bluesky client for iPhone, iPad, and the first Bluesky client for Apple Vision Pro.
